citations.assessment: The pinned entry supplies the Misha heading and its local son’s name. The gloss separately transmits the patronymic proposal.
The named witness gives Miasha as the son of R. Yehoshua ben Levi. Compare the gloss’s proposed grandson reading without adopting it.
